kapak.alt: Little use, in the hardest setting

youtube.baslik: Why is someone who wears hearing aids only at crowded gatherings unhappy? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In the example case, data logging shows average daily use of only an hour and a half, and about half of that time was in noisy speech settings; so the device was used most in the hardest setting, and the brain had no chance to get used to hearing with it. An all-day wearing plan was made with the person, starting at home and in quiet places; crowded gatherings were to be the next step. At the six-week follow-up, the data log showed an average of seven hours a day; most of the dissatisfaction came not from the device itself, but from maintenance, settings, use and expectations.
